reason: Scheme support (PR #10145): PlayerFilter::AllExcept gains relation (PlayerRelation, default All) selecting the all-players vs opponents base, and TriggerMode gains AsSetInMotion for 'as you set this scheme in motion' choices. Both are serialized in GameState ability/filter/trigger definitions; older full-game and P2P peers cannot decode the new tag and would drop a non-default base on re-encode.
